parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, and hate-speech law was extended to trans people in 2020. Anti-discrimination in goods and services, a conversion-therapy ban and a 2022 Pride shooter sentenced to 30 years show protections operating. The security service reports declining threats, and hostility is described as concentrated among extremists, with a comparatively liberal climate. Against this, hate crimes rose 18% in 2023, clearance fell from 52% to 45%, only 8% of victims report, and 2019 survey data show elevated threats for LGBT people, though mostly online and undated for current visitor exposure. The dossier documents no border, document, facility or custody rules affecting visitors; these are open questions, not exposures, so they are not scored. Per-capita violence is not established. Overall: Reduced Risk, with an undercount and rising reports tempering strong institutions.
